collection.description: A patient initially improves after surgery, then develops pain and swelling around the old wound.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A patient initially improves after surgery, then develops pain and swelling around the old wound.

choices.label: Reopen the wound in another dangerous operation.
Clean, observe, and treat symptoms without further surgery.
Ask the patient whether they want another operation.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The healer drains trapped fluid, and the patient slowly recovers.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient survives the second procedure but remains very weak.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The infection spreads, and the patient dies.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The patient chooses to try again despite the risks.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The patient declines further surgery and asks for relief from pain.
